subject.title: docs: plan native UI mobile KMP migration

question: Should OpenClaw formally adopt the KMP module and hand-written Swift-facade architecture described by this page?
rationale: The document selects a durable build, dependency, API, and ownership model across Android and a shared iOS/macOS/watchOS package; source inspection can validate its assumptions but cannot authorize that direction.

options.title: Require an experiment first
options.body: Reframe the page as an investigation plan and require minimal Android and Apple build, link, and API proof before selecting KMP/SKIE.

options.title: Sponsor the architecture
options.body: Merge the decision record after named Android and Apple owners explicitly accept its compatibility and long-term maintenance costs.

options.title: Retain native implementations
options.body: Address only individually approved duplicated rules within the existing platform stacks and decline a shared KMP layer.

recommendation.title: Require an experiment first
recommendation.body: Reframe the page as an investigation plan and require minimal Android and Apple build, link, and API proof before selecting KMP/SKIE.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate across Android, OpenClawKit, and watchOS integration.
